title: Hellenic Parliament

terrainReference.basis: Original ground immediately west of the central projected portico at the Parliament approach.

mapIdentity.scope: Named native relation provides 36 outer controls with the portal projections and four inner court or lightwell polygons.

note: The exact two Qualla originals supply the Syntagma facade, ochre wall tone, stone cornices, centered Doric portico and shallow pediment. The Parliament’s history describes the three-storey wings and additional porticos.
